purpose: Computes N-entity corporate cash netting: gross inter-company positions to net positions to minimum settlement legs using the BIS CPMI greedy matching algorithm (Net Settlement Framework 2012). Reports wire-count savings and netting_efficiency_pct. Corporate cash netting only -- NOT estimate_ficc_margin_netting (FICC US-Treasury clearing). Netting statement suitable for anchor_batch Merkle-leaf receipts. ZERO PII: aggregate entity balances only, no account-holder identifiers.
